Regulation: B.C. Reg. 110/2026
Made under: Skilled Trades Bc Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 6, 2026

B.C. Reg. 110/2026, deposited July 6, 2026, under theSKILLED TRADES BC ACT[section 27 (1)]. Order in Council 290/2026, approved and ordered July 6, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the Skilled Trades BC Regulation, B.C. Reg. 252/2022, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — J. SUNNER,Minister of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills; C. BOYLE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 7 of the Skilled Trades BC Regulation, B.C. Reg. 252/2022, is amended (a)	by renumbering the section as section 7 (1), and (b)	by adding the following subsection: (2)	For the purposes of section 27 (1) of the Act, each of the following trades is designated as a skilled trades certification trade, effective July 5, 2027: Index Page|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: New BC skilled trades certification trades announced, effective July 5, 2027
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has added new trades to the list of 'skilled trades certification trades' under the Skilled Trades BC Act. This means that, starting July 5, 2027, workers in these trades will need to be certified (hold a recognized credential) to work in BC. The regulation was filed on July 6, 2026, and the change takes effect in 2027.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check if your trade is on the new list and start planning for certification requirements before July 5, 2027.

key_dates.label: New skilled trades certification trades take effect (BC)
